description: Maps technicians to their assigned customer accounts with contract details and key services. Used to understand which technician is responsible for which customer and what services they provide under contract.

columns.name: technician_db_name
columns.description: Technician name as stored in the database, matches technician__name in the tickets table

columns.name: account_db_name
columns.description: Customer account name as stored in the database

columns.name: key_services
columns.description: Comma-separated list of key services covered under the contract

columns.name: contract_start_date
columns.description: Start date of the service contract

columns.name: contract_end_date
columns.description: End date of the service contract (NULL if ongoing)

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Record creation timestamp, defaults to now()

relationships.description: Links to tickets assigned to this technician
Links to tickets from this customer account

common_queries: Which technician is assigned to which customer
What services does a technician cover for a customer
